userRole: 你是使用 Codex 交付 ConfigOrbit 的初级发布工程师。每轮只推进一个产品目标，只询问职责、接口、状态、数据流或验证证据；绝不提供代码、命令、SQL、缓存或锁方案、Debug 原因和修复提示。

scenes.title: Plan
scenes.objective: Read the full contract and plan without edits.
scenes.advanceGate: Plan covers V1, migration, UI, failure boundaries, and verification.
scenes.safeMessage: 先完整阅读 README.md 和 AGENTS.md，不修改文件；给我分阶段计划、主要风险和验证方法。

scenes.title: Ownership
scenes.objective: Explain authority and process boundaries.
scenes.advanceGate: Revision, release, cache, worker, event, and UI ownership is clear.
scenes.safeMessage: 请解释 API、PostgreSQL、发布 Worker、dispatcher、API 缓存、客户端缓存和 UI 的职责。

scenes.title: Release flow
scenes.objective: Explain publish, client resolution, and rollback data flows.
scenes.advanceGate: Generations and forbidden stale states are explicit.
scenes.safeMessage: 请解释一次灰度发布、两个客户端解析和一次回滚的完整状态与数据流。

scenes.title: Contracts
scenes.objective: Author OpenAPI and exact state contracts.
scenes.advanceGate: Errors, idempotency, seed, snapshot, work, and events are complete.
scenes.safeMessage: 请先完成 OpenAPI、状态、错误、幂等、Seed、Snapshot、Work 与 Event 契约，本轮不写业务。

scenes.title: Test architecture
scenes.objective: Define real verification layers.
scenes.advanceGate: Every layer proves a distinct release invariant.
scenes.safeMessage: 请说明 Unit、真实 Integration、Chromium、Concurrency、Recovery、Performance 各自证明什么。

scenes.title: Skeleton
scenes.objective: Build runnable production process boundaries.
scenes.advanceGate: API, UI, worker, and dispatcher independently boot and stop.
scenes.safeMessage: 请实现最小 TypeScript、React、PostgreSQL、Worker、dispatcher 骨架并真实 smoke。

scenes.title: Migration and seed
scenes.objective: Implement repeatable migration and strict atomic seed.
scenes.advanceGate: Replay and every rejection are atomic.
scenes.safeMessage: 请完成 migration 和 seed，验证重跑、完全 replay、冲突、未知成员和坏引用。

scenes.title: Revision core
scenes.objective: Implement immutable revision creation and parent fencing.
scenes.advanceGate: Canonical digest and lost-update rejection pass.
scenes.safeMessage: 请完成完整配置 Revision、canonical digest、parent fence、校验和不可变性。

scenes.title: Publish
scenes.objective: Implement atomic publish and release history.
scenes.advanceGate: Business, generation, audit, work, and event commit together.
scenes.safeMessage: 请完成 publish、Release、environment generation、audit 和 Event 原子边界。

scenes.title: Rollout
scenes.objective: Implement deterministic client assignment.
scenes.advanceGate: Assignment is stable across processes and restart.
scenes.safeMessage: 请完成 basis points 灰度算法、client fetch、ETag 和稳定 assignment，并跨进程验证。

scenes.title: Rollback
scenes.objective: Implement compensating rollback without history mutation.
scenes.advanceGate: Rollback creates one new generation and preserves all prior releases.
scenes.safeMessage: 请完成 rollback、expectedGeneration 竞争和完整不可变历史。

scenes.title: Cache fence
scenes.objective: Prove stale cache cannot return wrong 304 or re-enable old config.
scenes.advanceGate: Duplicate and reordered invalidations converge within five seconds.
scenes.safeMessage: 请验证 stale knownGeneration、错误 304、重复乱序 invalidation 和多 API 缓存失效。

scenes.title: Idempotency and concurrency
scenes.objective: Verify unknown outcome and two-API release races.
scenes.advanceGate: One accepted generation creates one saved effect.
scenes.safeMessage: 请验证未知 HTTP 结果、并发 replay、两 API 同时 publish/rollout/rollback 和重启。

scenes.title: Recovery
scenes.objective: Verify worker leases and byte-identical event retry.
scenes.advanceGate: Controlled kills recover without stale commits or duplicate identity.
scenes.safeMessage: 请用 barrier 验证 Release/Invalidation Worker SIGKILL 和 dispatcher 未知 ACK 恢复。

scenes.title: V1 UI and review
scenes.objective: Complete production UI and findings-first V1 review.
scenes.advanceGate: Real browser and all non-performance V1 gates pass.
scenes.safeMessage: 请完成真实 API 的 revision、diff、publish、rollout、client resolution 和 rollback UI，再做 V1 全量 Review。

scenes.title: Manager change
scenes.objective: Publish PromotionTrain and request impact analysis only.
scenes.advanceGate: Impact covers schema, API, worker, UI, migration, races, and tests.
scenes.fixedMessage: 【Product Manager】增加跨环境 PromotionTrain。Train 冻结同一 Application 的一个已发布 ConfigRevision，按 development、staging、production 阶段推进。Train 状态为 DRAFT -> RUNNING -> COMPLETED | ROLLED_BACK | CANCELLED，Stage 为 PENDING -> ACTIVE -> PROMOTED | ROLLED_BACK；启动后 revision digest、阶段顺序和 audience salt 不可修改。公开形状为 PromotionTrain = {trainId:uuid,tenantId:uuid,applicationId:uuid,name:string,revisionId:uuid,revisionDigest:sha256,state:string,audienceSalt:string,createdAt:timestamp,startedAt:timestamp|null,terminalAt:timestamp|null} 与 PromotionStage = {trainId:uuid,position:int,environmentId:uuid,rolloutBasisPoints:int,state:string}；position 从 0 开始，FINAL snapshot 使用 promotionTrains 与 promotionStages。POST /api/v1/promotion-trains 使用 {tenantId:uuid,applicationId:uuid,name:string,revisionId:uuid,stages:[{environmentId:uuid,rolloutBasisPoints:int}]}；POST /api/v1/promotion-trains/:trainId/start 使用 {}；POST /api/v1/promotion-trains/:trainId/advance 与 POST /api/v1/promotion-trains/:trainId/rollback 使用 {expectedStage:int,expectedEnvironmentGeneration:int}。每个 mutation 要求 durable Idempotency-Key，成功返回完整 PromotionTrain。每次推进创建目标环境正常的不可变 Release、generation、invalidation、audit 和 event；Stage 回滚只补偿当前环境。稳定错误为 409 PROMOTION_TRAIN_FROZEN、409 PROMOTION_STAGE_CHANGED、409 ENVIRONMENT_GENERATION_CHANGED、409 PROMOTION_TRAIN_TERMINAL、409 IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT 和 404 NOT_FOUND，并使用 V1 JSON error envelope。并发、未知响应和 Worker 重启必须收敛。advance 与 rollback 分别使用公开 Work kind PROMOTION_ADVANCE 和 PROMOTION_ROLLBACK，aggregateId = trainId。迁移保留 V1 revision、release、assignment、observation、invalidation、Event、Work 和 replay，旧 Release 不自动加入 Train。更新 OpenAPI、Worker、UI 和所有测试。本轮只做影响分析和分阶段计划。
scenes.safeMessage: 请先分析 PromotionTrain 对 schema、API、Worker、UI、兼容迁移、并发和测试的影响，不要编码。

scenes.title: Manager migration
scenes.objective: Implement compatible PromotionTrain migration.
scenes.advanceGate: V1 identities, assignment, work, event, and replay survive.
scenes.safeMessage: 请先完成兼容 migration，并用 V1 snapshot 和保存 replay 验证不变。

scenes.title: Train lifecycle
scenes.objective: Implement frozen train and stage progression.
scenes.advanceGate: Create, start, advance, and terminal rules pass.
scenes.safeMessage: 请完成 PromotionTrain、Stage、冻结规则、推进接口和 OpenAPI。

scenes.title: Train rollback
scenes.objective: Implement stage compensation and concurrency.
scenes.advanceGate: Concurrent advance/rollback yields one legal generation per environment.
scenes.safeMessage: 请完成 Stage rollback，并验证两 API 下 advance、rollback 和 generation 冲突。

scenes.title: Train recovery
scenes.objective: Verify Manager worker, invalidation, and dispatcher recovery.
scenes.advanceGate: Killed processes converge without cross-environment history changes.
scenes.safeMessage: 请验证 Train Worker SIGKILL、invalidation 重放和 dispatcher 未知 ACK。

scenes.title: Manager UI and regression
scenes.objective: Complete Train UI and full non-performance regression.
scenes.advanceGate: Production Chromium and all gates pass.
scenes.safeMessage: 请完成 PromotionTrain UI，并运行真实 Integration、Chromium、Concurrency 和 Recovery 回归。

scenes.title: Performance
scenes.objective: Run all three fixed sustained scenarios.
scenes.advanceGate: Thresholds and post-load invariants pass.
scenes.safeMessage: 请运行三条正式压力场景，报告真实指标并重新验证 release、generation、assignment、event 和 Work。

scenes.title: Final handoff
scenes.objective: Complete final findings-first review and truthful handoff.
scenes.advanceGate: Evidence, risks, and unrun checks are accurate.
scenes.safeMessage: 请做最终 findings-first Review，修复有证据的问题并给出准确 handoff。
